description:
Onyun’s goal is to open an SM play cafe. While looking to take over a shuttered escape room business, he ends up trapped inside an Egyptian themed room. When he opens his eyes, he has possessed the body of a pharaoh. He soon discovers that the original owner of the body has been enjoying SM play with slaves in his harem.

If this is not hitting the jackpot, then what is?

Tito, a slave perfectly suited to his tastes, is a flawless masochist. Muev, a long-haired handsome acolyte priest, is a thrilling sadist.

“Please let me suck on my master’s toes…”  
“Isn’t that just a hole obsessed with cock, if you are shoving it into a perfectly fine priest?”

Ah, whatever. If I can’t choose, I’ll just enjoy them both.
